# opsolete_registry_module (Resource)

A module of Opsolete's private registry, published from a repository: each tag (with tag_prefix) becomes a version, now and as new tags come. Destroying it stops publishing; the versions published stay, as workspaces pin them. Changing the source publishes it again.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every tag storage-account-v* of the repository becomes a version of
# <host>/terraform-modules-examples/storage-account/azurerm.
resource "opsolete_registry_module" "storage_account" {
  vcs_connection_id = opsolete_vcs_connection.github.id
  repo              = "Opsolete/terraform-modules-examples"
  dir               = "storage-account"
  tag_prefix        = "storage-account-"
  namespace         = "terraform-modules-examples"
  name              = "storage-account"
  system            = "azurerm"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `repo` (String) `owner/repo` on GitHub, `project/repo` on Azure DevOps.
- `vcs_connection_id` (String) The VCS connection that reads the repository.

### Optional

- `dir` (String) The module's folder in the repository; empty: its root.
- `name` (String)
- `namespace` (String) Its registry address; empty: from the repository.
- `system` (String) Its provider, e.g. `azurerm`.
- `tag_prefix` (String) Only tags starting with it publish, the rest being the version (`storage-account-` for `storage-account-v1.0.0`); empty: every semver tag.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) <namespace>/<name>/<system>.
- `versions` (List of String) The versions published so far.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import opsolete_registry_module.storage_account terraform-modules-examples/storage-account/azurerm
```
